signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Free users get 5 chapter credits to start, plus 5 more every month (resets on the 1st).
When you reach your limit, you can wait for your monthly reset, purchase chapter credits, or upgrade your plan.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 4.2/5 vs 4.03/5 all-time (+0.17). 18% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $49 tier lacks 0 of 5 features in the $99 tier and includes a zero allowance.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 1.0 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $49 vs a stated $89 regular price (45% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We reserve the right to modify free plan limits at any time.
We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time.

trials.claim: Tier 3 includes 50 AI illustrations per month for illustrated books
trials.claimQuote: 50 AI illustrations/mo Illustrated books (picture, coloring, and ABC included)
trials.reasoning: A Tier 3 buyer reports being told they must upgrade to Tier 4 to use full illustrations, which directly limits the promised Tier 3 illustration inclusion.

exhibits.quote: Do I have to upgrade to Tier 4? I was informed I have to upgrade my account to use full illustrations.
exhibits.argument: A Tier 3 buyer reports being told full illustrations require upgrading to Tier 4, undermining that Tier 3 includes 50 illustrations per month.

trials.claim: Tier 4 includes 100 AI illustrations per month for illustrated books
trials.claimQuote: 100 AI illustrations/mo Illustrated books (picture, coloring, and ABC included)
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit is the vendor's regular pricing showing 50 images per month, which does not show what deal-specific Tier 4 buyers actually receive.

exhibits.quote:
- 30 audiobook chapters/month

- Illustrated picture books (50 AI images/month)

- 60 book videos/month (no "Made with" mark on the end card)
exhibits.argument: The vendor's own pricing caps illustrated picture books at 50 AI images per month, contradicting 100 per month for Tier 4.

trials.claim: Future Creator or Premium plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Creator (Tiers 1-2) or Premium (Tiers 3-4) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The terms quote concerns free plan limits, not Creator or Premium updates, and the review quote is too vague to show future plan updates were withheld.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify free plan limits at any time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to change limits at any time, undermining a promise of included future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: The Last T4 added made me lost trust and instead of accepting the big jump i decided to downgrade
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports a new T4 tier was added as a paid jump instead of an included update, undermining future updates being included.

trials.claim: Go from prompt to finished exportable book in PDF, EPUB, DOCX
trials.claimQuote: Go from a prompt to a finished, exportable book in PDF, EPUB, or DOCX format with AI writing and cover design
trials.reasoning: The vendor states a single prompt becomes a finished, export-ready ebook and confirms PDF, EPUB, and DOCX export; the prosecution exhibits only warn about polish and possible AI errors, not exportability.

exhibits.quote: Each has its strengths, but the reality is that no writing app—Inkfluence AI included—can produce a polished, professional-quality book from a single prompt.
exhibits.argument: A user states the app cannot produce a polished professional-quality book from a single prompt, contradicting prompt-to-finished-book.

exhibits.quote: May contain factual inaccuracies, outdated information, or unintended errors
exhibits.argument: The vendor discloses AI output may contain inaccuracies and errors, undermining a finished exportable book from a prompt.

exhibits.quote: Inkfluence AI is a full-stack book creation platform that turns a single prompt into a finished, export-ready ebook.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states the platform turns a single prompt into a finished export-ready ebook.

exhibits.quote: PDF, EPUB, and DOCX export - Print-ready files for Amazon KDP, Etsy, Gumroad, or client delivery
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms export in PDF, EPUB, and DOCX formats.

trials.claim: Complete book can be written from one prompt with structured chapters
trials.claimQuote: Describe your idea and get a fully structured book with chapters, sections, and content drafted automatically
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes automatic chapter-by-chapter outlines and full book generation, and a buyer confirms quality content from just one prompt; isolated complaints about polish or one confused story do not materially undercut that.

exhibits.quote: Each has its strengths, but the reality is that no writing app—Inkfluence AI included—can produce a polished, professional-quality book from a single prompt.
exhibits.argument: The review directly rejects that a single prompt yields a complete structured book, contradicting the one-prompt claim.

exhibits.quote: the ai got completely confused on a simple fiction attempt and mixed the opening scene
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the AI confused story structure on a simple attempt, undermining automatic structured chapters and content.

exhibits.quote: Pick a genre, name your topic, and watch a chapter-by-chapter outline write itself. The full book is one more click.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes automatic chapter-by-chapter outline and full book generation from a topic.

exhibits.quote: I have been genuinely surprised by the ease of use of Inkfluence and the quality of the content it created with just one prompt.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms quality content creation from just one prompt.

trials.claim: Offers 33 book types across fiction, cookbooks, guides and more
trials.claimQuote: Choose from 33 book types spanning fiction, cookbooks, guides, lead magnets, workbooks, and more
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly lists 33 book types including fiction, non-fiction, workbooks, cookbooks, and guides, with no contradicting exhibit.

exhibits.quote: 33 book types - Fiction, non-fiction, workbooks, cookbooks, guides, devotionals, and more
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists 33 book types spanning fiction, cookbooks, guides and more.
